summary: Track the fleet refactoring metrics work in the repository Planfile store

delivery.outcome: The repository Planfile store carries PLF-002 for the fleet refactoring metrics delivered by ticket-030, so the work is visible to a Planfile-driven queue and the two remaining delegation blockers are recorded where a queue reader will find them.
nonGoals: Run planfile sync github in any direction (import reverted in #29; export defective per semcod/planfile#126)
Add .planfile/.koru/policy.yaml, which koru fleet uses to discover opted-in projects
Change any source, test or governance artifact

architecture.decision: Record the ticket in the existing single-YAML Planfile store with no integration mapping. A mapping is deliberately absent: reconciliation acts on every ticket holding one, and the export path currently records mappings onto pull-request numbers, which is what broke every sync run before #29.
dataChanges: PLF-002 added to .planfile/sprints/current.yaml; next_id advances in .planfile/config.yaml
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; no external system holds a mapping to PLF-002.

commands: planfile ticket list -s current --status all --format json
validation.evidence: PLF-002 present in current sprint: status=open, priority=high, sync={} (no mapping).
Export dry run reports 'Found 1 tickets for github' and lists only PLF-001, so PLF-002 is never reconciled.
